existing_spatial_field.rule: Load the accepted 12-control field unchanged. It is a historical frozen baseline parameter and is never refitted, altered, averaged, or used to fit the Phase 16 residual.

accepted_intensity_saturation.rule: Load centre, normalization, and accepted saturation-only slope unchanged; hue slope is exactly zero. These controls are not refitted.

boundary_conditioned_gain.rule: Fit the existing gain procedure independently for each verified shot from every frame belonging to that shot, stride 1. It is a frozen baseline adaptation, not a Phase 16 residual-field fit.

temporal_isolation.cache_rule: Open the existing [73274,73460) cache once; use only strict views [0:21], [21:160], and [160:186]. Never build a sub-shot cache.
temporal_isolation.field_fit_rule: Every normal-equation accumulator, threshold sample collection, alpha calculation, metric accumulator, gain fit, and output parameter record has exactly one shot_id.
forbidden: cross-shot parameter reuse other than the frozen historical baseline constants
averaged field, gain, alpha, threshold, or coefficient parameters
temporal state, fusion, smoothing, or pooling

spatial_train_holdout.thresholds: P50 and P90 of HDR low-frequency ICtCp chroma over that shot's TRAIN samples only; P50 labels low chroma and P90 labels high chroma for both TRAIN and HOLDOUT evaluation.

new_residual_field.shape_normalization: Normalize each Ct/Cp shape to unit RMS over that shot's stride-4 spatial TRAIN samples.
new_residual_field.alpha_formula: alpha_raw = mean_train(unit_rms_shape * lowpass_residual); alpha_shrunk = alpha_raw / (1 + 0.05); alpha = clip(alpha_shrunk, -0.25, 0.25).
new_residual_field.application: Apply alpha_t*field_Ct and alpha_p*field_Cp additively to the sigma-16 Ct/Cp base after frozen baseline A, then re-add unchanged Ct/Cp detail. I is copied unchanged. For extension rows, y is clipped to [-1,1] before basis evaluation, so the field extends continuously from the nearest overlap boundary without extrapolating a higher-order polynomial.

metrics.deltaE2000: Auxiliary only; BT.2020 is converted to BT.709 and normalized to the frozen 203 nit white before Lab/CIEDE2000.
metrics.seam: Measure top/bottom chroma and hue steps plus luminance mean/P95 across the exact HDR-centre composite boundary.
metrics.composite: Copy HDR exactly into every overlap row [140,940) for both A and B. This makes the amplified A/B residual exactly zero in the HDR centre; only extension and seam rows can differ.

reporting.aggregate_rule: Calculate only equal-shot descriptive metric means after all independent shot reports. Never aggregate or use model parameters.
